Adds a beta feature on top of [1.0.1](https://github.com/pioacosta/PKTool/releases/tag/v1.0.1).

**Download `PKTool.nds` below** and replace the old one on your SD card. Your saves, backups, Bank and settings stay as they are.

## New: back up a GBA cartridge's save (beta)

On a **DS or DS Lite**, with a Pokémon **Ruby, Sapphire, Emerald, FireRed or LeafGreen** cartridge in the GBA slot, press **SELECT** in the save browser:

- PKTool reads the cartridge's save and keeps a copy in `/PKTOOL/gba/` (for example `BPEE_20261014-153000.sav`), then opens it.
- It is **read-only for the cartridge**: nothing is written to its data. Your edits go to the copy on the SD card.
- The copy is only kept if the save was read identically twice and it is a valid Gen III save; otherwise you get a message saying what went wrong (no cartridge, not a Pokémon game, bad contact, no save yet).
- The DSi and the 3DS have no GBA slot, so the option does not appear there.

**This is a beta: it has not been tested with a real cartridge yet.** If you try it, please open an issue and tell me what happened, whether it worked or not.
